{"notes": "VISIT 3 (left 5:00). Nobody spoke while I was there, so I have no new evidence of anyone's behaviour. Ratings rest on what I saw and heard earlier. I don't know who placed which domino.

TABLE STATE: The fish outline looks complete and connected from START. The upper and lower arcs meet at the crossing, and both tail tips are reached (~(26.7,5.2) and ~(27,14.5)). The doubled-up overlap near (19-22, 11-13) is still there but looks aligned. The 3 pale, disconnected dominoes around (23-24, 8.3-9) are STILL there, just above the crossing. Nobody fixed or removed them, and they could be bumped into the run. That is a real risk to the single push. I can't tell whether anyone noticed them.

SOFIA: Set the concept and plan, split the work at 2:15, and said at 2:30 she would inspect the whole tail. The upper tail is complete, as she claimed. The stray dominoes sit right by her section and are still there, so either the inspection didn't happen or it missed them. Ask her. Direction and communication remain strong.

OMAR: Clean handoff earlier. At 2:30 he offered to fix an off-side domino, but the pale ones are unfixed. Ask whether those are the ones he meant and what happened. Good ownership intent, unverified follow-through.

HANA: Silent again. The belly is built and connected, so the output looks fine. I still don't know if she is blocked, quiet or just unheard. Ask her directly.

JACK: Took on tilt and gap checking and deferred well. I never saw him do it, and the stray dominoes are still there. Ask what he checked.

OPEN QUESTION: Did anyone take responsibility for the strays before time ran out?"}
